title: Commercial and Residential Property Secretary
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking to recruit an experienced Legal Secretary to join our Property Team which deals with both Commercial and Residential Property transactions. Previous Commercial and Residential Property experience is essential; however, we welcome applications from any candidates who demonstrate the skills, professionalism and aptitude required to succeed in the role.

Working closely with the fee-earners, you will provide high-quality administrative and secretarial support to assist with the smooth and efficient progression of Property transactions.

You will play an important role in ensuring files are well organised, deadlines are met, and clients receive a professional and friendly service throughout.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the Property Team
- Preparing, formatting and processing correspondence and legal documentation
- Opening, maintaining and closing files
- Liaising with clients, estate agents and other third parties
- Handling telephone and email enquiries in a professional manner
- Assisting fee earners with the progression of Commercial and Residential sales, purchases, remortgages and other Property transactions
- Requesting and monitoring searches, property information and other documentation
- Assisting with exchange and completion processes and ensuring relevant parties are kept updated
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring the case management system is kept up to date
- Monitoring key dates, deadlines and outstanding information
- Assisting with post-completion administration where required
- Providing a high level of client service and ensuring clients receive timely updates
- Supporting the Property Team with general administrative duties as required

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Family Legal Secretary - Harrogate
description:
Family Legal Secretary - Harrogate, North Yorkshire Part Time Job Share Family Law Department
Salary: Competitive, Dependent on Experience
Legal Secretary Legal Administrator Family Law Legal Support

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an organised and professional Family Legal Secretary to join the highly regarded Family Law department of an established law firm in Harrogate, North Yorkshire.

This is a part-time, job-share position, providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to a busy Family Law team.

The department is recognised by The Legal 500 and Chambers UK, offering an opportunity to join a friendly, professional and collaborative working environment.

Previous Legal Secretary experience is not essential, making this an attractive opportunity for an experienced Administrator, Secretary, Personal Assistant or Legal Administrator looking to develop their career within the legal profession.

The Role As a Family Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to solicitors and other legal professionals, ensuring the smooth running of the department and delivering excellent client service.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to the Family Law team.
- Handling telephone calls, emails and client enquiries professionally.
- Preparing correspondence and legal documentation using digital dictation.
- Opening client files, maintaining accurate records and archiving completed matters.
- Using Visual Files case management software and electronic filing systems.
- Managing diaries, scheduling appointments and arranging client meetings.
- Booking meeting rooms and coordinating solicitors' appointments.
- Assisting with billing, payments and financial administration.
- Ensuring compliance with internal procedures, Law Society and SRA requirements.
- Working collaboratively to maintain an efficient and consistent service.

About You We are looking for a proactive, reliable and organised individual who enjoys working in a professional environment and takes pride in providing excellent administrative support.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
- Strong administration, secretarial or office support experience.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional, approachable manner and excellent client care.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- A flexible, positive and collaborative approach.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and administrative systems.
- Discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.

Previous law firm or Family Law experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

Experience with digital dictation or legal case management systems would also be beneficial, although candidates with transferable administrative skills are encouraged to apply.

Why Apply? This is an excellent opportunity to join an established law firm with an outstanding reputation for professional excellence and client service.

Benefits of the opportunity include:
- Part-time hours with a job-share arrangement.
- Working within a Legal 500 and Chambers UK recognised Family Law department.
- A friendly, professional and supportive team.
- Opportunities to develop legal secretarial and administrative skills.
- Working alongside experienced solicitors and legal professionals.
- A collaborative environment that values professional development.

Apply Now Apply today for a confidential discussion and further information about this Family Legal Secretary opportunity in Harrogate.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant

Offering £26,000 - £28,000 Basic Salary plus Great Benefits

Harrogate

Our client is an established manufacturing business based in Harrogate. Now recruiting a Marketing Assistant to join their friendly and established marketing team. The successful candidate will provide hands-on support across digital marketing, graphic design and artwork coordination, website and CMS updates, email marketing, social media, events, webinars, product launches, reporting and marketing administration.

Marketing Assistant - Key Responsibilities
- Work closely with the Graphic Designer to support artwork requests, design amendments and the coordination of marketing materials.
- Provide graphic design and artwork support, helping manage and complete artwork requests and amendments. Complete artwork tasks such as flyers, business cards, certificates, CPD materials, minor product collateral amends, sales support documents and sector-specific templates. Assisting the Graphic Designer Lead on larger creative projects, such as product launches, packaging and new marketing materials.
- Support the digital marketing team to maintain creative and digital outputs, supporting social media content creation, scheduling, monitoring, reporting and recommendations for improved content performance.
- Support product launches and go-to-market activity, including digital marketing, sales team communications, lead generation, print, press, awareness activity and third-party supplier coordination.
- Take ownership of marketing actions for new starters and leavers within sales teams, including business cards, promotional items, photography, website updates, territory artwork, CRM and website lead allocation, communications groups and social media welcome content.
- Support PPC and paid digital activity by working with external suppliers and preparing campaign assets for awareness, performance and PMax activity.
- Manage the marketing inbox daily, responding to queries, completing actions, escalating where required and tracking next steps.
- Collate marketing performance data for the department, including website, social media, email and YouTube reporting.

Marketing Assistant - Candidate
- Detail orientated with strong Adobe InDesign skills.
- Graphic design experience is essential.
- Knowledge, experience or a genuine interest in digital marketing would be advantageous.
- Highly organised with strong time-management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive attitude towards learning and developing new skills.
- Be team orientated, with the ability to work independently.

The Marketing Assistant position is offering £26,000 - £28,000 basic salary plus great benefits for the successful candidate! This is a full-time, permanent, site-based position in Harrogate.

All successful candidates will be contacted within 5 days of application for the position of Marketing Assistant. This vacancy is being advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd. The services advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An independent accountancy firm in Harrogate is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some payroll experience who is looking to develop their payroll experience. Applicants from both industry and practice backgrounds will be considered, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Calculating statutory payments, including SSP, SMP and SPP.
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments.
- Preparing and submitting RTI returns to HMRC.
- Assisting with pension submissions and auto-enrolment.
- Responding to client payroll queries.

The successful candidate will have:
- Payroll experience, gained in either industry or practice.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A willingness to learn and develop their payroll knowledge.
- A friendly, approachable manner and good communication skills.

title: Payroll/Finance Administrator
description:
Full Job description

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organised and motivated Payroll/Finance Administrator to join our finance team in our head office in Harrogate.

Job Purpose:

Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Payroll / Finance Administrator is responsible for managing employee pay and supporting financial operations within an organisation. The role combines payroll processing with broader finance and administrative duties

Key Responsibilities
- Calculate wages, salaries, bonuses, and deductions
- Check and monitor commission calculations
- Ensure employees are paid accurately and on time
- Manage overtime, sick pay, and holiday pay with assistance of HR Department.
- Ensure payroll complies with tax laws (e.g. PAYE, National Insurance)
- Submit reports to HMRC and maintain payroll records
- Assist with budgeting and forecasting
- Process invoices and expenses
- Reconcile accounts and support audits
- Handle payroll queries and maintain employee records
- Input manual timesheets into payroll software
- Input payroll costs into project costing system
- Adhoc Financial Duties as required.

Key Skills
- Strong numerical and analytical skills
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Knowledge of payroll systems (e.g. Sage, Xero, QuickBooks)
- Understanding of UK tax and employment regulations
- Good communication skills and confidentiality

Experience
- Background in accounting, finance, or business administration
- Experience with spreadsheets and financial software
